decisions.rationale: Primary independently reviewed "The steady-state error of a system depends on the number of poles at the origin for L(s)=G_c(s)G(s)H(s). A pole at the origin can be considered an integration, and therefore the steady-state accuracy of a system ultimately depends on the number of integrations in the loop transfer function." (ctkg:v3e-object-0005c17b837d3fc1abc69c23). The frozen evidence selectors are confined to aggregate/profile provenance and bind no independent current-course lesson or syllabus evidence. Inclusion and exclusion are therefore both unsupported for this object.
